title: Wooden Roll Knife Sharpener, 20° – The Angle Is Already Set
seo_title: Wooden Roll Knife Sharpener, 20° – Magnetic Angle Block
seo_description: Wooden roll knife sharpener with a magnetic angle block marked 20° and a roller with 2 diamond discs. The angle is set from the start, no guessing by hand.
descriptionHtml:
Your hand guesses the angle every time you sharpen

An ordinary sharpening stone gives you nothing to hold against – the angle changes with every stroke, and the result is rarely the same twice. After a while it's as much guessing as sharpening.

A block that locks the angle for you

The magnetic wooden angle block is marked 20° and holds the knife in place while you pull the roller with the two diamond discs back and forth. The sharpener comes in a black box with a manual.

Features

  • The angle is marked 20° – the block holds the knife in the same position from the first stroke to the last.
  • Magnetic holder – the knife stays against the block instead of you having to hold it steady yourself.
  • 2 diamond discs on the roller – the sharpening surface is already mounted, nothing loose to lose.
  • Block and roller in wood – not plastic that gets scratched after a while.
  • Black box with manual – unpack it and use it right away.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

No information on angles other than 20° – the block is only marked with that angle.

Our guarantee

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
